subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if:

'+' is changed with '-'

'-' is changed with '÷'

'÷' is changed with '+'

'×' is unchanged

120 - 6 + 31 ÷ 8 × 11 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given statement : 120 - 6 + 31 ÷ 8 × 11 = ?

According to the question, after interchanging the signs :

__
 
• 
 
'+' is changed with '-'

 
 
• 
 
'-' is changed with '÷'

 
 
• 
 
'÷' is changed with '+'

 
 
• 
 
'×' is unchanged

 

So,

​**120 ÷ 6**__ - 31 + 8 × 11 = ?​

20 - 31 + __**8 × 11**__ = ?

__**20 + 88**__ - 31 = ?

__**108 - 31**__ = ?

**77 = ?**

Hence, "Option - (77)" is the correct answer.

79
